title: Newlin Grist Mill

services.name: Educational Programs
services.desc: Education at Newlin Grist Mill: A History and Nature Preserve. Our comprehensive educational program fully leverages the site’s unique blend of history, traditional trades, and natural resources. We offer a wide variety of interdisciplinary, hands-on tours, demonstrations, and programs adaptable to different curricula and age groups (preschool through high school and beyond). Building upon Newlin’s existing resources-including hearth cooking, blacksmithing, archaeology, and traditional woodworking programs-the curriculum will emphasize experiential learning while demonstrating the continued relevance of traditional knowledge, craftsmanship, and problem-solving skills.
